title: silene aprica var. oldhamiana
intro: Silene aprica var. oldhamiana, commonly known as Star of Bethlehem, is a flowering plant in the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, including its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The health benefits of Silene aprica var. oldhamiana include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
